column1: # THE EBIN BUILD STEPS (F-225; make/elixir.mk build/elixir-tables-ebin.config,
# one make after another, in order, each asking for build/elixir-tables-ebin/.stamp
# with a stand-in compile. "compile <options>" means the compile ran and saw
# ERL_COMPILER_OPTIONS=<options> ("-" for none) over <units> table units;
# "current" means make took the ebin as built. At c7852e0047 the stamp did not
# depend on the options: the "default" step after "fast" was "current" and the
# allocation audit and soak would have measured the [no_ssa_opt] BEAM.
